style.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, mist blue #D9EAF8 for info and packaging shots, deep steel blue #3E6C9B for structure and trust shots

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean fresh oral-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist blue #D9EAF8, deep steel blue #3E6C9B, pure white #FFFFFF and one sky-grey accent #6FA8CE; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line circle-frame icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; stable upright product presentation and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright slight 3/4 product presentation; pick head always readable; sachets shown as flat sealed rectangles
